findings.description: At 00:02 two chrome bullet-shaped ornaments are visible on the hood (one at the front edge, a second further back mid-hood). At 00:00 and again at 00:04 only the single front hood ornament exists, and the mid-hood object never reappears. The extra ornament appears and vanishes with no camera or car movement that could explain it, indicating a generation/duplication artifact.
